calculate_agricultural_zakat.description: Work out ushr, the zakat on agricultural produce: a tenth of a rain-fed crop, a twentieth of an irrigated one, because irrigation cost the grower something. Unlike zakat on wealth there is no threshold to clear and no year to wait - it falls due at harvest. No API key required.

calculate_zakat.description: Work out the zakat due on savings, gold, silver, shares, business stock and other investments, less what is owed. Gold and silver are priced from the live market, so only the weight is needed. Nothing is due below the nisab threshold, and the result shows its working: what was counted, what was deducted, which threshold it was measured against and at what prices. Zakat is due on wealth held for a lunar year, which nothing here can check. No API key required.

list_new_moons.description: List the coming new moons with the date each crescent should first be visible and which Hijri month it starts. The conjunction and the sighting are not the same event - the new moon is an instant, and the crescent appears a day or so later, which is when the month actually begins. The step to plan around Ramadan or Dhu al-Hijjah months ahead. No API key required.

description: Twelve Islamic services behind one connection, all of it free and keyless: the Qur'an in twelve translations with word-by-word meanings and thirteen reciters, 36,000 hadiths across ten collections, four tafsir works, prayer times for anywhere with 23 calculation methods, the qibla, the Hijri calendar, 126 duas, the 99 names, 210 Islamic given names, a zakat calculator fed by live gold and silver prices, and moon sighting. Quote a verse, post a hadith, send prayer times every morning, remind people before an Eid, or work out what somebody owes in zakat. No account or API key required.
